summary: HERO (Hybrid Emergency Route Optimizer) is an end-to-end, real-time intelligence emergency services routing solution built on Microsoft Fabric, that decides the fastest path for an ambulance applying a “siren advantage” model. Winner of the Microsoft Fabric Global Hackathon 2025.
